note: double hyphen becomes an en dash
triple hyphen becomes an em dash
a dash at the start of a line still converts
a quote right after an opening parenthesis still curls the right way
an apostrophe inside a word is not a closing quote
an apostrophe before a digit is an elision, not an open quote (issue #122)
known wrong: SmartPunct reads both apostrophes as quote marks, not elisions. Kept as the shared answer so all three implementations agree.
